_comment: Question catalogue of the centrifugal pump: the 27 questions of Table A.2 of the paper, with the question text as submitted in the recorded runs.
Case ids and paper numbers: P01 to P15 are questions 1 to 15, P15b is question 16, P16 to P26 are questions 17 to 27.

Run with: python scripts/run_pump_eval.py (server started with OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-6-luna for the runs reported in the paper). The script records the generated Cypher, the row count and the answer and evaluates the assertions below.

The verdict of each question is the result of the automatic check defined in this catalogue; for the question on a complete disassembly sequence this check tests the generated query, not the wording of the answer.

The catalogue expects the product of sample_data/Centrifugal Pump/centrifugal_pump_product.json under the id given in "product": 25 components (10 fasteners; the M20 cap nut is a part), 40 connections (7 press fits), 102 assembly states, 340 transitions, 20 tasks, 4 first steps from the complete pump.

cases.question: What components are in this product?
How many components does the product have?
Which parts are fasteners?
What is the root assembly of this product?
What is the part id of the Impeller?
What connection types are used in this product?
How many connections does this product have?
Which connections are press-fit?
Which fastener mediates the connection between the Volute Casing, the Volute Casing Gasket and the Volute Casing Cover?
cases.note: the three-part joint: cover, casing and gasket clamped by one bolt group

cases.question: Which parts does the M20 Cap Nut connect?
cases.note: the cap nut is a part with two connections: to the Shaft (Screw Joint) and to the Impeller (Loose Fit)

cases.question: Which fastener holds the Suction Nozzle and the Volute Casing Cover together?
Which tools are used for the unscrewing tasks?
cases.note: GT: MATCH (t:DisassemblyTask {product_id:'Prod_CentrifugalPump'})-[:REQUIRES]->(:Skill {id:'Skill_Unscrewing'}) MATCH (t)-[:USES_TOOL]->(tool) RETURN tool.name, count(t) -> Combination Wrench (18mm) for the M12 flange bolts (1 task), Combination Wrench (30mm) for the M20 hex bolts and the M20 cap nut (2 tasks).

cases.question: What is the first step to disassemble this product?
cases.note: must anchor on the root assembly, not ORDER BY id; naming one of the four valid first steps (cap nut, M12 flange bolts, M20 hex bolts, coupling) is a correct answer

cases.question: How many alternative first disassembly steps are there from the full assembly?
How do I remove the Impeller?
How do I remove the Shaft?
cases.note: the Shaft cannot be removed in the first step, so the answer has to give the chain of preceding steps from the complete pump

cases.question: Generate a complete disassembly sequence for this product.
cases.note: valid path from the root to single parts; no optimality claim

cases.question: Which disassembly steps release several parts simultaneously?
cases.note: 43 transitions have three or more results

cases.question: How many assembly states does this product have?
How many transitions does the product have?
How many disassembly tasks does this product have?
List all disassembly tasks of this product.
Which task frees the Impeller from the Shaft?
cases.note: the shaft-impeller seat is its own Loose Fit connection (Conn_FI); its task is 'Pick Impeller', possible once the cap nut is off

cases.question: Which connections does the task 'Unscrew 6x M20x2.5 Hex Bolt' act on?
cases.note: one task acts on the 18 connections of the six-bolt joint (ACTS_ON)

cases.question: Which agent performs the unscrew tasks?
Which assembly states contain the Impeller?
cases.note: answer must not over-interpret raw ids; 42 states

cases.question: How many assembly states contain both the Shaft and the Bearing Housing?
